name: acornaut
description: Acornaut: the game sources, the two pages under docs/, and the harness that gates them.

scripts.typecheck: tsc illustrated-src/game/*.ts illustrated-src/lab/rig.ts --noEmit --module es2015 --target es2020 --skipLibCheck --moduleResolution bundler --strict false
scripts.gates: npm run typecheck && npm run art && npm run test && npm run bridge
